pageSource.description: Sets up, audits and repairs a manifest-driven CI/CD pipeline that publishes a collection of agent skills to a Cloudflare Pages site, with a generated page per skill. Use when someone asks for CI/CD or automation for a skills site, wants a new skill repo to appear on the site with its own page, asks why a skill is missing or its page is stale, or needs a red publish run diagnosed and a bad deploy rolled back. It installs one GitHub Actions workflow with check, publish and discover jobs, a committed manifest as the publication decision, generated hub rows, discovery indexes, sitemap and pages, and verification gates on both sides of the deploy. Not for releasing one skill through the marketplace, tarball or plugin channels (use publish-release-gate), checking unpushed work or listing drift (use upstream-check), deciding whether a build is safe to launch (use release-gate), or writing and tuning a skill (use draft-skill or tune-skill).

skills.name: seo-crawl
skills.title: SEO Crawl
skills.blurb: Crawls a site you own and returns deterministic, evidence-backed technical SEO findings, with blocked or unrun checks reported INCONCLUSIVE rather than a pass.
skills.stats: 14 files · 1,885 lines · 19 KB

pageSource.description: Use when you need evidence about the technical SEO state of a site you own or are authorized to crawl, covering HTTP statuses and redirects, indexability (meta and header robots), robots.txt, canonical tags, titles, meta descriptions, H1s, internal links, sitemap coverage, and static JSON-LD. Runs a bounded, read-only crawl and returns deterministic findings JSON with stable IDs and explicit INCONCLUSIVE checks, so an SEO audit or content change starts from measured evidence instead of guesses. Trigger phrases include "crawl the site for SEO", "check sitemap coverage", "find broken internal links", "why is this page not indexed", "check titles and metas", "canonical audit", and "pre-audit crawl". Not for Search Console clicks, impressions, rankings or keyword volumes; Core Web Vitals, Lighthouse or bundle performance; release security and exposed files; content rewriting or keyword strategy.
